layers.name: 19th Century Australian Bushfire Reporting
layers.description:
This dataset represents places associated with 19th century Australian bushfires; whether they are directly affected or only proximate to the event. Placenames have been harvested from over 5000 19th century Australian newspaper articles. Placenames in each article that occur within a 200 character count of the word 'bushfire' have been extracted and geo-located using the GHAP.  This character proximity yields a strong, if unqualified, relationship between
place and disaster.
layers.creator: Fiannuala Morgan
